messages:
Alyssa CSM: Morning team — Harbor Health onboarding is ~65% complete and their consumption is already at 78% of committed monthly credits.
Marco (CS Ops): thanks, saw the spike overnight. they're using a lot of embeddings for search fine-tuning.
Priya (Finance): oof — 78%... renewal in 34 days, right? can we get a 30/60/90 spend projection?
Alyssa CSM: yes renewal 34d out. Dan, can you confirm if new product tests will continue at the same rate next month?
Dan Harbor (Customer): we're ramping but we can pause non-prod embed jobs if it helps. want to avoid throttling user-facing features.
billing-bot: Alert: account/harbor projected_to_cross_commit_threshold=0.92 within 12 days — threshold email sent to account contacts.
Marco (CS Ops): quick forecast I pulled (rough):
```
current_month_commit = 500k tokens
used = 390k (78%)
proj_linear = 520k (next 30d)
proj_with-new-tests = 680k
```
Marco (CS Ops): recommendation: enable a soft quota at 90% and schedule a targeted enablement session to optimize prefixes & caching.
Priya (Finance): +1. also propose a temporary retainer or short-term add-on to cover burst while we optimize.
Alyssa CSM: I'll book a 30-min enablement call for Wed 10am PT focused on embedding batching and KV cache. Marco can you prepare the runbook and a short config snippet?
Marco (CS Ops): putting together a two-slide runbook and this config sample:
```
redwood.alerts.create({
  account: "harbor",
  rule: "proj_spend>commit*0.9",
  notify: ["alyssa@redwood.com","priya@redwood.com"]
})
```
Priya (Finance): that alert looks good. Also request a forecast export (CSV) for the renewal deck.
Alyssa CSM: Dan — if you can confirm whether the non-prod jobs can be scheduled off-peak, we can probably shave 15-20% off peak token usage.
Dan Harbor (Customer): yes we can gate non-prod. i'll provide a list by EOD.
Alyssa CSM: perfect. Action items:
- Marco: runbook + enablement slides + alert config (by EOD)
- Priya: export 30/60/90 forecast for renewal deck (by EOD)
- Dan: non-prod job list + expected ramp schedule (by EOD)
I'll follow up after the enablement call with recommended commit add-on options.
Marco (CS Ops): noted :thumbsup:
Priya (Finance): thanks all :pray:
Alyssa CSM: thanks team — will post the calendar invite and attach the forecast CSV. :calendar:
